scenes.text: Mac users have the Dynamic Island.
So I asked a simple question.
Not a notch that copies Apple. A place where your work happens.
Start a focus session on any task. FLOAT holds your notifications, and pauses for your meetings.
Copy text from anything on screen. Even images.
Paste your clipboard into any app.
Search apps, files and settings. Or just type a command.
Apple's curves. Real glass. Spring motion.
Private. Everything stays on your PC. Free, and open source.
FLOAT. The island Windows was missing.
